jp_grezzo: "なんだ、ぬしは。私は弱いものには興味がないのだ。フハハハハ！"

en_grezzo: "Begone. I have no interest in weak soldiers. Muwahahaha!"
it: Vattene. I deboli non mi interessano. Muahahah!

jp: オパートスの名にかけて！貴殿はかの有名なではないか？貴殿の腕を見込んで頼みがあるのだ。

en_grezzo: "By Opatos! You are the famous " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", are you not? I have a favor I'd like to ask of someone like you."
contesto: chatMore lang("オパートスの名にかけて！貴殿はかの有名な" + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + "ではないか？貴殿の腕を見込んで頼みがあるのだ。", "By Opatos! You are the famous " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", are you not? I have a favor I'd like to ask of someone like you.")
it: "Per Opatos! Ma tu sei " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + " in persona! Ho un favore da chiedere a chi vale come te."

jp_grezzo: "話を聞こう"

en_grezzo: "(Hear him out.)"
it: (Stare a sentire)

jp: 止めておこう
jp_grezzo: "止めておこう"
en: (Don't get involved.)
en_grezzo: "(Don't get involved.)"
it: (Non immischiarsi)

jp: 私はジューアの解放軍の大佐、ギルバートと申す。軍といっても国軍ではないが、イェルスの犬に占拠された各地のジューア自治区を、解放してまわっておるのだ。その我が軍が、パルミア国境でイェルスの強力な防衛線の前に苦戦しておる。最新鋭の武装を持つ奴らに対し、我らは剣に頼るのみ。このままでは、全滅する恐れさえあるのだ。どうか、貴殿の力、貸してもらえぬか？
jp_grezzo: "私はジューアの解放軍の大佐、ギルバートと申す。軍といっても国軍ではないが、イェルスの犬に占拠された各地のジューア自治区を、解放してまわっておるのだ。その我が軍が、パルミア国境でイェルスの強力な防衛線の前に苦戦しておる。最新鋭の武装を持つ奴らに対し、我らは剣に頼るのみ。このままでは、全滅する恐れさえあるのだ。どうか、貴殿の力、貸してもらえぬか？"
en: I am colonel of the Juere Liberation Army, Gilbert. We're not the true national army, but even so we fully intend to free the Juere Territories from their occupation by those Yerles dogs. However, our army is having a hard time breaking through their strong front lines on the Palmia border. We only have our swords against their advanced weapons, after all. If things go on like they are, our army might be totally annihilated. So I ask you, will you lend us your power?
en_grezzo: "I am colonel of the Juere Liberation Army, Gilbert. We're not the true national army, but even so we fully intend to free the Juere Territories from their occupation by those Yerles dogs. However, our army is having a hard time breaking through their strong front lines on the Palmia border. We only have our swords against their advanced weapons, after all. If things go on like they are, our army might be totally annihilated. So I ask you, will you lend us your power?"
it: Sono Gilbert, colonnello dell'esercito di liberazione juere. Non siamo l'esercito regolare, ma abbiamo tutta l'intenzione di liberare i territori juere dall'occupazione di quei cani di Yerles. Solo che al confine di Palmia le nostre truppe faticano contro una linea difensiva formidabile: loro hanno armi all'avanguardia, noi soltanto le spade. Di questo passo rischiamo di essere annientati. Perciò te lo chiedo: vuoi prestarci la tua forza?

jp: フハハハハッ。腰抜けめ。
jp_grezzo: "フハハハハッ。腰抜けめ。"
en: Mwahahaha! You damn coward!
en_grezzo: "Mwahahaha! You damn coward!"
it: Muahahah! Ti manca il fegato!

jp: フハハハァッ。そうこなくてはならぬ。貴殿の力、頼りにしておる。戦の準備ができ次第、声をかけてくれ。
jp_grezzo: "フハハハァッ。そうこなくてはならぬ。貴殿の力、頼りにしておる。戦の準備ができ次第、声をかけてくれ。"
en: Mwahahaha! Good, good. We'll be counting on you. Once you've prepared, come speak to me again.
en_grezzo: "Mwahahaha! Good, good. We'll be counting on you. Once you've prepared, come speak to me again."
it: Muahahah! Così mi piace. Contiamo su di te. Quando sei in ordine torna a parlarmi.

jp: いい
jp_grezzo: "いい"
en: They are.
en_grezzo: "They are."
it: Sono a posto

jp: だめ
jp_grezzo: "だめ"
en: Not yet.
en_grezzo: "Not yet."
it: Non ancora

jp: 準備はいいかな？
jp_grezzo: "準備はいいかな？"
en: Are your preparations complete, then?
en_grezzo: "Are your preparations complete, then?"
it: I preparativi sono a posto, dunque?

jp: 待っておるぞ。
jp_grezzo: "待っておるぞ。"
en: We're waiting on you.
en_grezzo: "We're waiting on you."
it: Ti aspettiamo.

jp: フハァ。貴殿にオパートスの加護のあらんことを祈っておるぞ！
jp_grezzo: "フハァ。貴殿にオパートスの加護のあらんことを祈っておるぞ！"
en: Hahaha! I pray Opatos' favor be with you!
en_grezzo: "Hahaha! I pray Opatos' favor be with you!"
it: Ahah! Che la protezione di Opatos sia con te!

jp: フアハァァァァハハハ。フハー！ファハハハ、フ、フハッ、ブ、ブバァッ…ゲホッ…ゲホ…す…すまん。震えるほど興奮したぞ、ぬしの雄姿に。解放軍も、これで無事にパルミアの国境を越えることができる。どうか、この感謝の気持ちを受け取ってくれ。
jp_grezzo: "フアハァァァァハハハ。フハー！ファハハハ、フ、フハッ、ブ、ブバァッ…ゲホッ…ゲホ…す…すまん。震えるほど興奮したぞ、ぬしの雄姿に。解放軍も、これで無事にパルミアの国境を越えることができる。どうか、この感謝の気持ちを受け取ってくれ。"
en: Muwahahahah! Muwahahahahaha! Mu-mu...wa...! *cough* *cough* My... My apologies. Your heroic figure striding across the battlefield was so amazing that even I was shaken. With this, the Liberation Army can pass the borders of Palmia. Please, accept this reward as my thanks.
en_grezzo: "Muwahahahah! Muwahahahahaha! Mu-mu...wa...! *cough* *cough* My... My apologies. Your heroic figure striding across the battlefield was so amazing that even I was shaken. With this, the Liberation Army can pass the borders of Palmia. Please, accept this reward as my thanks."
it: Muahahahah! Muahahahahah! Mu-mu... ah...! *tosse* *tosse* Chiedo... chiedo scusa. Il tuo valore sul campo di battaglia mi ha scosso fin nelle ossa. Adesso l'esercito di liberazione può varcare il confine di Palmia. Accetta questa ricompensa, come segno della mia gratitudine.

jp: さん、あなたとまた会話できるとは光栄です！
jp_grezzo: "" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "さん、あなたとまた会話できるとは光栄です！"
en: I hope we can talk again sometime, !
en_grezzo: "I hope we can talk again sometime, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!"
contesto: chatMore lang("" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "さん、あなたとまた会話できるとは光栄です！", "I hope we can talk again sometime, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!"), strbye
it: "Spero che ci sia occasione di riparlare, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!"

jp: パルミア軍第十連隊は、カミカゼ特攻隊の猛攻により大苦戦中です！敵は弾幕の雨の中を潜り抜け、戦死を前提とした自爆攻撃を繰り返しています。このままでは、我が部隊は全滅の恐れもあります。どうか、援軍に向かってください！
jp_grezzo: "パルミア軍第十連隊は、カミカゼ特攻隊の猛攻により大苦戦中です！敵は弾幕の雨の中を潜り抜け、戦死を前提とした自爆攻撃を繰り返しています。このままでは、我が部隊は全滅の恐れもあります。どうか、援軍に向かってください！"
en: Right now, the 10th regiment of the Palmian army is entrenched in battle with the suicide squadron! The enemy has broken through our suppression fire and now they're assaulting us with suicide bombers. The enemy know they're going to die and they're trying to take us with them. How can we fight an enemy with no regard for his own life! At this rate it looks like we'll be totally annihilated! We need you to lend us your hand and lead the reinforcements.
en_grezzo: "Right now, the 10th regiment of the Palmian army is entrenched in battle with the suicide squadron! The enemy has broken through our suppression fire and now they're assaulting us with suicide bombers. The enemy know they're going to die and they're trying to take us with them. How can we fight an enemy with no regard for his own life! At this rate it looks like we'll be totally annihilated! We need you to lend us your hand and lead the reinforcements."
it: In questo momento il decimo reggimento dell'esercito di Palmia è impegnato in battaglia contro lo squadrone kamikaze! Il nemico ha sfondato il nostro fuoco di sbarramento e ci assale con attentatori suicidi: sanno di morire e vogliono portarci con loro. Come si combatte un nemico che non tiene alla propria vita? Di questo passo saremo annientati! Ci serve che tu ci dia una mano e guidi i rinforzi.

jp: 引き受ける
jp_grezzo: "引き受ける"
en: I accept.
en_grezzo: "I accept."
it: Accetto

jp: やめておこう
jp_grezzo: "やめておこう"
en: That sounds... dangerous. No thanks.
en_grezzo: "That sounds... dangerous. No thanks."
it: Sembra pericoloso... no, grazie

jp: 無念です！
jp_grezzo: "無念です！"
en: I'm sorry to hear that.
en_grezzo: "I'm sorry to hear that."
it: Mi dispiace sentirlo.

jp: 助かります。準備ができ次第、声をかけてください。必ず遠隔武器を持参してください！
jp_grezzo: "助かります。準備ができ次第、声をかけてください。必ず遠隔武器を持参してください！"
en: Thank the gods. Call me when you're prepared. Be sure to bring a ranged weapon!
en_grezzo: "Thank the gods. Call me when you're prepared. Be sure to bring a ranged weapon!"
it: Grazie al cielo. Chiamami quando sei in ordine. E mi raccomando: porta un'arma da Tiro!

jp: いい
jp_grezzo: "いい"
en: Okay, let's roll.
en_grezzo: "Okay, let's roll."
it: Bene, si parte

jp: だめ
jp_grezzo: "だめ"
en: I'm not ready yet.
en_grezzo: "I'm not ready yet."
it: Non ancora, aspetta

jp: 準備はよろしいですか？あなたは、パルミア軍が撤退するまでの間、どうにかカミカゼ特攻隊の猛撃に耐え、時間稼ぎをして下さい。
jp_grezzo: "準備はよろしいですか？あなたは、パルミア軍が撤退するまでの間、どうにかカミカゼ特攻隊の猛撃に耐え、時間稼ぎをして下さい。"
en: Are you ready to go? We need you to hold off the suicide squadron's onslaught and buy time for the Palmian army to retreat.
en_grezzo: "Are you ready to go? We need you to hold off the suicide squadron's onslaught and buy time for the Palmian army to retreat."
it: Sei in ordine? Ci serve che tu regga all'assalto dello squadrone kamikaze e guadagni tempo per la ritirata dell'esercito di Palmia.

jp: 早くしてください！
jp_grezzo: "早くしてください！"
en: Hurry up!
en_grezzo: "Hurry up!"
it: Sbrigati!

jp: 伝令に現地まで案内させます。くれぐれも、奴らの接近を許さないように！パルミア軍の撤退が完了次第、連絡を入れます。
jp_grezzo: "伝令に現地まで案内させます。くれぐれも、奴らの接近を許さないように！パルミア軍の撤退が完了次第、連絡を入れます。"
en: I'll guide you to the battlefield then. Whatever you do, don't let them get close! I'll tell the Palmian army to begin a steady retreat.
en_grezzo: "I'll guide you to the battlefield then. Whatever you do, don't let them get close! I'll tell the Palmian army to begin a steady retreat."
it: Allora un messo ti porterà sul posto. Qualunque cosa succeda, non lasciarli avvicinare! Ti farò avvisare appena la ritirata sarà completa.

jp: お疲れ様であります。まさか、あの死地から戻って来ることができるなんて！戦友の無事も確認し、感謝の言葉もありません。どうかこの報酬を受け取ってください。
jp_grezzo: "お疲れ様であります。まさか、あの死地から戻って来ることができるなんて！戦友の無事も確認し、感謝の言葉もありません。どうかこの報酬を受け取ってください。"
en: Well done. I can't believe you made it back alive! I've heard my comrades are safe. I can find no words to express my gratitude. Please take this reward.
en_grezzo: "Well done. I can't believe you made it back alive! I've heard my comrades are safe. I can find no words to express my gratitude. Please take this reward."
it: Ottimo lavoro. Non credevo che da quel massacro si potesse tornare! I miei commilitoni sono salvi: non ho parole per ringraziarti. Accetta la ricompensa.

jp: おお、おぬしか。先の依頼の件、恩に着るぞ。どうだ、わしの部下になる気はないか？
jp_grezzo: "おお、おぬしか。先の依頼の件、恩に着るぞ。どうだ、わしの部下になる気はないか？"
en: Ahh, it's you. I owe you for what you've done for me. What do you say? Why don't you join my unit?
en_grezzo: "Ahh, it's you. I owe you for what you've done for me. What do you say? Why don't you join my unit?"
it: Ah, sei tu. Per quel favore ti devo molto. Che ne dici, non ti va di entrare nel mio reparto?

jp: まかせて
jp_grezzo: "まかせて"
en: Leave it to me!
en_grezzo: "Leave it to me!"
it: Ci penso io!

jp_grezzo: strbye
en: No way.
en_grezzo: "No way."
it: Neanche per sogno

jp: 困った…困ったぞ。そこのおぬし、良いところに来た。実はヨウィンがミノタウロスの軍による侵攻の危機にさらされておるのだ。ヨウィンの村長とは親しくしておって、一軍を討伐に向かわせたいのだが、今は何やら不穏な空気がパルミアを包んでいる。城から離れるわけにはいかないのだ。そこで、冒険者のおぬしに依頼したい。ミノタウロスを退治してきてはくれぬか？報酬はもちろん用意しよう。
jp_grezzo: "困った…困ったぞ。そこのおぬし、良いところに来た。実はヨウィンがミノタウロスの軍による侵攻の危機にさらされておるのだ。ヨウィンの村長とは親しくしておって、一軍を討伐に向かわせたいのだが、今は何やら不穏な空気がパルミアを包んでいる。城から離れるわけにはいかないのだ。そこで、冒険者のおぬしに依頼したい。ミノタウロスを退治してきてはくれぬか？報酬はもちろん用意しよう。"
en: What do I do about this... You, over there... You couldn't have gotten here a moment too soon. Yowyn is in great danger of being destroyed by the minotaur legion. The mayor of Yowyn is a close friend of mine and I don't want to leave him out in the cold. I want to send a detachment to reinforce him but I can't. The current political climate in Palmia is too volatile and the troops must remain in the castle. That's why I'm asking an adventurer like you. Will you attack the minotaur's camp for me? I will reward you handsomely if you do this.
en_grezzo: "What do I do about this... You, over there... You couldn't have gotten here a moment too soon. Yowyn is in great danger of being destroyed by the minotaur legion. The mayor of Yowyn is a close friend of mine and I don't want to leave him out in the cold. I want to send a detachment to reinforce him but I can't. The current political climate in Palmia is too volatile and the troops must remain in the castle. That's why I'm asking an adventurer like you. Will you attack the minotaur's camp for me? I will reward you handsomely if you do this."
it: Che guaio... che brutto guaio. Ehi, tu: non potevi capitare in un momento migliore. Yowyn rischia di essere rasa al suolo dall'esercito dei minotauri. Il capovillaggio di Yowyn è un caro amico e non voglio lasciarlo nei guai, ma un distaccamento non posso mandarlo: l'aria che tira a Palmia è troppo pesante e le truppe devono restare al castello. Per questo mi rivolgo a te, che vai all'avventura. Vuoi andare tu ad attaccare il covo dei minotauri? La ricompensa, naturalmente, sarà all'altezza.

jp: やはり、おぬしには無理か…
jp_grezzo: "やはり、おぬしには無理か…"
en: I knew you'd refuse... and after all, why wouldn't you?
en_grezzo: "I knew you'd refuse... and after all, why wouldn't you?"
it: Lo sapevo... e in fondo, chi non rifiuterebbe?

jp: なに、真か！では早々にミノタウロスの巣窟に向かい、首領を退治して来てもらいたい。場所は確かヨウィンの南と聞いておる。頼むぞ！
jp_grezzo: "なに、真か！では早々にミノタウロスの巣窟に向かい、首領を退治して来てもらいたい。場所は確かヨウィンの南と聞いておる。頼むぞ！"
en: What? You will? Great! Head to the Minotaur's Nest south of Yowyn and take the head of the minotaurs' king. Godspeed, .
en_grezzo: "What? You will? Great! Head to the Minotaur's Nest south of Yowyn and take the head of the minotaurs' king. Godspeed, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "."
contesto: chatMore lang("なに、真か！では早々にミノタウロスの巣窟に向かい、首領を退治して来てもらいたい。場所は確かヨウィンの南と聞いておる。頼むぞ！", "What? You will? Great! Head to the Minotaur's Nest south of Yowyn and take the head of the minotaurs' king. Godspeed, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "."), strbye
it: "Come? Davvero?! Magnifico! Va' al covo dei minotauri, a sud di Yowyn, e portami la testa del minotauro re. Che le divinità ti accompagnino, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "."

jp: どうした？おぬしが早くせんと、ヨウィンが危ないのだ。頼むぞ。
jp_grezzo: "どうした？おぬしが早くせんと、ヨウィンが危ないのだ。頼むぞ。"
en: What's wrong? You must make haste. Yowyn is in grave danger.
en_grezzo: "What's wrong? You must make haste. Yowyn is in grave danger."
it: Che c'è? Devi fare in fretta: Yowyn è in grave pericolo.

jp: おぬしか、待っておったぞ。報告はいい。すでに、ミノタウロスの王を倒した英雄のことは、この耳に伝わっておるわい。わしの感謝の印だ、受け取ってくれ。
jp_grezzo: "おぬしか、待っておったぞ。報告はいい。すでに、ミノタウロスの王を倒した英雄のことは、この耳に伝わっておるわい。わしの感謝の印だ、受け取ってくれ。"
en: You've returned. I've been waiting for you. I've already heard the good word about the hero who crushed the minotaur king. Take this as a sign of my eternal gratitude.
en_grezzo: "You've returned. I've been waiting for you. I've already heard the good word about the hero who crushed the minotaur king. Take this as a sign of my eternal gratitude."
it: Eccoti, ti aspettavo. Non serve il rapporto: la voce di chi ha abbattuto il minotauro re mi è già arrivata all'orecchio. Prendi questo, come segno della mia gratitudine.
